At lower-right midground, clearly separate smaller enemy group of 3-5 ragged YELLOW HEADWRAP rebels RUNNING AWAY rightwards ahead of horses, backs shown, one turns afraid toward Guan Yu; dropped yellow banner, no yellow headwrap on heroes. Explicit pursuit story, not Guan Yu leading Yellow Turbans. Mud splashes beneath hooves, limited peach petals and small peach branch at left connect oath story.
Far sky behind hero: a translucent PURE GREEN spirit dragon apparition, visibly smaller and less materialized than a higher-tier physical dragon. Continuous long neck/body/tail, open sweeping silhouette not closed ring, moderate majestic volume with sky visible through it. Entire head, horns, mouth and nose within x150–800 y180–400, nose less than x810. Distant protective apparition, not a solid pet next to rider. Maintain simple grounded battlefield with hills, no floating palaces.
Style: original mythic Three Kingdoms manga game-card art, crisp designed sculptural forms, simplified smooth skin, bold sweeping cloth planes, dramatic foreshortening, restrained directional supernatural light; not photograph, not realistic sunset, not patchy oil. Main face, guandao and powerful mounted silhouette read first. Distinct side chase composition, NOT frontal standing slash, NOT rear-view dragging blade. No UI, letters, watermarks.
